notes.title: FLOWERS -Le volume sur hiver- is now on Steam!
notes.content:
FLOWERS -Le volume sur hiver- is finally here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26005076/c26b1067b8ccebc6e355fc278ae4dc059cfe893d.png[/img]

With the coming of Winter, the year comes to a close, and so does Suoh's journey for the truth about her her beloved Mayuri, who went missing in spring. This final chapter is crafted with all of the beautiful prose and incredible artwork the series is known for.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1921560/Flowers_Le_volume_sur_hiver/

Thank you for your continued support, and we sincerely hope you enjoy the conclusion to FLOWERS!

If you want to keep up with JAST, consider giving our social media a follow!

Twitter: https://twitter.com/jastusa
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/jastusa

And of course, our discord is open and always welcoming new members!
discord.gg/rMGjzQE

notes.title: Flowers -Le volume sur automne- is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
We're very happy to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1238730/Flowers_Le_volume_sur_automne/]Flowers -Le volume sur automne-[/url] is now available on Steam! Plus, during its launch week you can purchase it with a special 10% discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1238730/Flowers_Le_volume_sur_automne/

As the leaves turn and strange incidents continue to plague the isolated Saint Angraecum Academy, interweaving threads of emotion tangle together in an intricate story of love and truth.

Continue the story in the third visually stunning game of the Flowers visual novel series from Innocent Grey. It will capture your heart with its complex characters, beautiful artwork, memorable soundtrack, and engaging story. As you unravel the story, your decisions will shape the outcome.

We look forward to hearing about your thoughts on Flowers -Le volume sur automne-. Thank you all for your support and we hope you enjoy playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38308816/3d0c8a42620d51ded3987960a86936ae0aa4f65c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Flowers -Le volume sur printemps- is now available in Chinese
notes.content:
Happy Lunar New Year!
We’re excited to announce the Flowers series is getting official Chinese localizations, in addition to English.

You can get the Chinese language versions of Flowers Spring and Summer now on Steam. The next upcoming title in the series,  Flowers -Le volume sur automne-, will also include both language options.

notes.title: Update & Regional Availability
notes.content:
[h1]Game Update[/h1]
A new update is now live. Changes include:
[list]
    [*]Minor update to translation in chapter 8
    [*]Fix to a text rending bug in chapters 2 & 5
    [*]Fix to a text error that affected some single quotes
[/list]

[h1]Regional Availability Issue Update[/h1]
Regional availability has been corrected, but there are reports of no launch discount for those regions. We've contacted valve for them to correct this issue. [b]Update: The launch discount issue has been fixed and is now available in all regions![/b]
